description: Tráfego, detecções do IDS, mapa de ameaças, kill chain, narrativas LLM e saúde do pipeline.

panels.title: Eventos/s
panels.description: Eventos publicados por segundo, somando todos os agentes.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "network_traffic")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "pipeline_metrics" and r._field == "events_per_sec")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
  |> group(columns: ["_time"])
  |> sum()
  |> group()
  |> sort(columns: ["_time"])

panels.title: Eventos no período
panels.description: Pacotes analisados que viraram evento no período selecionado.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "network_traffic")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "traffic" and r._field == "bytes")
  |> group()
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: count, createEmpty: false)

from(bucket: "network_traffic")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "traffic" and r._field == "is_scan" and r._value == 1.0)
  |> group()
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: count, createEmpty: false)

panels.title: IPs atacantes
panels.description: IPs de origem distintos com pelo menos um ataque.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "network_traffic")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "traffic" and r._field == "is_scan" and r._value == 1.0)
  |> group()
  |> distinct(column: "src_ip")
  |> count()

from(bucket: "network_traffic")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "traffic" and r._field == "kc_score" and r._value >= 80.0)
  |> group()
  |> distinct(column: "src_ip")
  |> count()

panels.title: Agentes ativos
panels.description: Agentes que enviaram métricas nos últimos 2 min.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "network_traffic")
  |> range(start: -2m)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "pipeline_metrics" and r._field == "events_per_sec")
  |> group()
  |> distinct(column: "agent_id")
  |> count()

from(bucket: "network_traffic")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "traffic" and r._field == "bytes")
  |> group(columns: ["protocol"])
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: count, createEmpty: false)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({_time: r._time, _value: r._value, _field: r.protocol}))
  |> group(columns: ["_field"])

panels.title: Ataques ao longo do tempo
panels.description: Detecções por janela, por tipo de ataque.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "network_traffic")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "traffic" and r._field == "is_scan" and r._value == 1.0)
  |> group(columns: ["attack_type"])
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: count, createEmpty: false)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({_time: r._time, _value: r._value, _field: r.attack_type}))
  |> group(columns: ["_field"])

panels.title: Origem dos ataques
panels.description: IPs de origem com ataque, geolocalizados (GeoIP no nta-server). Tamanho = número de eventos.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "network_traffic")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "traffic")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "lat" or r._field == "lon" or r._field == "is_scan")
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["_time", "src_ip"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => exists r.lat and exists r.lon and r.is_scan == 1.0)
  |> group(columns: ["src_ip"])
  |> reduce(identity: {lat: 0.0, lon: 0.0, eventos: 0, ataque: ""},
            fn: (r, accumulator) => ({lat: r.lat, lon: r.lon, eventos: accumulator.eventos + 1, ataque: r.attack_type}))
  |> group()

panels.title: Ataques por tipo
panels.description: Total de detecções por tipo no período.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "network_traffic")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "traffic" and r._field == "is_scan" and r._value == 1.0)
  |> group(columns: ["attack_type"])
  |> count()
  |> group()
  |> sort(columns: ["_value"], desc: true)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ataque: r.attack_type, eventos: r._value}))

panels.title: Top atacantes
panels.description: Maior kc_score por IP de origem, com o último estágio da kill chain e o último ataque visto.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "network_traffic")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "traffic" and r._field == "kc_score")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => exists r.kill_chain_stage and exists r.attack_type)
  |> group(columns: ["src_ip"])
  |> sort(columns: ["_time"])
  |> reduce(identity: {score: 0.0, eventos: 0, estagio: "", ataque: "", asn: "—", ioc: "—"},
            fn: (r, accumulator) => ({
              score: if r._value > accumulator.score then r._value else accumulator.score,
              eventos: accumulator.eventos + 1,
              estagio: r.kill_chain_stage,
              ataque: r.attack_type,
              asn: if exists r.asn_org then r.asn_org else accumulator.asn,
              ioc: if exists r.ioc_source then r.ioc_source else accumulator.ioc}))
  |> group()
  |> sort(columns: ["score", "eventos"], desc: true)
  |> limit(n: 12)
  |> keep(columns: ["src_ip", "score", "estagio", "ataque", "asn", "ioc", "eventos"])

panels.title: Kill chain por IP
panels.description: Estágio da kill chain de cada IP ao longo do tempo (RECON → EXPLOIT → EXFIL).

targets.query:
from(bucket: "network_traffic")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "traffic" and r._field == "kc_score")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => exists r.kill_chain_stage and r.kill_chain_stage != "IDLE")
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({_time: r._time, src_ip: r.src_ip, _value: r.kill_chain_stage}))
  |> group(columns: ["src_ip"])
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: last, createEmpty: false)

panels.title: Narrativas de incidente (LLM)
panels.description: Última narrativa de cada IP com kc_score ≥ 80, gerada pelo nta-server via LLM (Groq). Últimas 24 h.

targets.query:
import "strings"
from(bucket: "network_traffic")
  |> range(start: -24h)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "incident_narrative" and r._field == "narrative")
  |> group(columns: ["src_ip"])
  |> sort(columns: ["_time"])
  |> last()
  |> group()
  |> sort(columns: ["_time"], desc: true)
  |> limit(n: 10)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with _value: strings.replaceAll(v: r._value, t: "\\n", u: " ")}))
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "src_ip", "attack_type", "kill_chain_stage", "_value"])
